Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has one open question from finance:
we're looking at a phased SKU uplift (usage-based tiers) and need clarity on how
Redwood will sequence channel pass-through credits across the first 90 days of a PO.
Specifically:
- Will channel partner credits be applied at invoice or via a post-invoice rebate?
- If post-invoice, what is the expected timing for pass-through settlement?
- We also need a simple matrix showing list price smoothing if we accelerate uplift
  in month 2.

Can you flag who from your side owns the ops flow and provide any supporting
term-sheet language or examples? We aim to finalize the PO next week.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Senior Procurement Manager
FinHealth

Hi Emma,

Thanks — good questions. Looping in Olga (Partner Ops) and Marcus (Pricing)
who own channel settlement and private-offer terms. Short answers up front:
- We typically route partner credits via post-invoice rebate (monthly aggregation).
- Settlement lag is usually 30–45 days after invoice, unless we agree an invoice-level
  routing (possible for committed reserved capacity purchases).
- We can supply a 'smoothing' matrix to show netbacks when an uplift frontloads.

I've attached a mock term sheet and an uplift schedule that shows month-by-month
examples (see attachments). Olga/Marcus — can you confirm the standard pass-through
 timing and whether invoice-level pass-through can be made available for a 12-month
commit with a two-month ramp?

Next steps: we'll send a one-page summary and a worked example by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0123

sku_uplift_schedule.xlsx (worked example)

--- Message 3 (internal) ---
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
From: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Subject: Re: Private offer — initial uplift window question

Connor,

Quick notes:
- Default: monthly post-invoice rebate to partner; 30-day settlement window after
  month close (i.e., invoice issued then partner receives rebate within ~30d).
- Invoice-level pass-through: operationally possible but requires our finance
  to pre-approve an invoice routing workflow; that typically adds 2 weeks to
  onboarding but can be committed in contract for large reserved purchases.
- For a 12-month commit with 2-month ramp we recommend an 'anchored smoothing'
  approach: apply a capped uplift credit in month 1 and true-up in months 2–3.

I've updated the uplift workbook with two sequences: (A) default rebate path and
(B) invoice-routing path with an example of cashflow timing. I've also attached
SOC2 summary for their procurement team.

If Procurement needs faster settlement, we can propose an escrow-triggered
interim credit (small admin fee) — flag if they want to explore.

-Olga
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: sku_uplift_schedule.xlsx (v2), SOC2-summary.pdf
